messages:
alex: Observed mid-stream auth failure in staging: client keeps pushing, auth service rotates token, upstream rejects and we close connection -> client sees EPIPE. Repro below.

mira: Drop the repro and env?

alex: Staging:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer short' https://frontdoor.redwood/v1/stream -d @payload.json
# trigger refresh for subject while stream active
```
After refresh, stream stalls then abrupt close. No structured error.

sam: Options: eager_check (stall on refresh), delegate_lease (frontdoor issues ephemeral lease), or require resume-trailers from upstream. Each has different security/latency tradeoffs.

ingrid: Proposal: hybrid approach to minimize client impact and rollout surface:
- default behavior: amortize via short conn-lease (x-rdwl-conn-lease) TTL 5s for conversational/read routes.
- on upstream rejection: frontdoor attempts to emit structured trailer with x-rdwl-resume-hint if upstream can provide one; otherwise return canonical error code and hint to client.
- write-heavy routes default to eager_check to avoid double-delivery risk.

kevin: Key guardrails: bind lease to TLS session hash and client IP, route-scoped permissions on lease (read-only vs write), TTL config per-route, log issuance to audit stream.

sam: Route config sketch:
```
route.auth_policy = "eager_check|amortize_lease|reject_with_trailer"
route.resume_policy = "none|client_initiated|server_trailer"
```

mira: Testing plan: unit tests for header propagation, integration test simulating auth-service slow refresh, staging chaos toggling auth_policy on a fraction of traffic, and client-sdk resume handler stub.

ingrid: Metrics to add: conn_lease_issued, conn_lease_violations, midstream_rejects, resume_hints_emitted, resume_successes. Dark-launch leases and monitor before opt-in per-route.

alex: Docs: document timeout semantics clearly: if amortized, client-visible timeout starts at accept; if eager_check, starts after auth gate.

kevin: Security: request quick review focused on replay, lateral movement, and minting controls. Also consider short-lived KMS key with limited use for lease signing.

alex: Action items:
- ingrid: draft RFC with sequence diagrams and schema (ETA Thu)
- sam: list of routes that must be eager (ETA Tue)
- mira: test harness + client resume stub (ETA Fri)
- kevin: security review request (ETA Wed)

deploy-bot: feature flag created in staging: frontdoor.conn_lease (canary) :rocket:
